_comment: Ed25519 (public_key, message, signature) triple produced by the vendored Python implementation engine/ed25519.py (RFC 8032). ed25519CrossImplFixtureTest in BoardSignatureTests verifies it with Apple CryptoKit, so a regression in either implementation that would break board-signature verification is caught. Secret key used: RFC 8032 TEST 1 secret (9d61b1...7f60). Regenerate with the snippet in engine/tests/test_ed25519.py's module docstring.
